newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fowl odour leads police to rotten chickens.
newsitem.headline: Fowl odour leads police to rotten chickens.

text.p: A "fowl" odour led French police to 5.5 tonnes of rotten chicken in the broken-down refrigerator of a Riviera poultry firm, law enforcement authorities said on Thursday.
Police initially followed their noses to a van selling spoiled roasted chickens in the marketplace of the Riviera resort town of Mandelieu near Cannes.
They then tracked the scent back to the supplier, Rotisseries Mediteraneennes in nearby Antibes, which sells chickens across Provence and the Riviera.
The rotten poultry was seized and then destroyed.
